Jewelry Valuation Widget Subscription

The Jewelry Valuation Widget lets you embed a free, no‑account calculator on your site that shows the value of diamonds, gold, and other gemstones. It uses CaratBase’s 250+ reference pages and 21 gem types, and it works directly on your website.

How to Add the Widget

  1. Choose the widget you need—ring sizer, diamond size chart, or gold calculator—on the /widgets.html page.
  2. Copy the short code snippet.
  3. Paste it into your site’s HTML.
  4. Visitors see a live calculator that displays current market values.
  5. When they submit a request, the inquiry goes straight to you, the jeweler, with no attribution line.

What You Get

  • Cost: $12 per month per domain.
  • No attribution: The widget shows no “Powered by CaratBase” line.
  • Custom call‑to‑action: Direct visitors to your store or contact form.
  • No account required: You can start using the widget immediately.

FAQ

What is the monthly cost of the widget? $12 per month per domain.

Do I need an account to use the widget? No. You can start using the widget immediately.

Can I use the widget on multiple pages of my site? Yes. The same code snippet works on any page.

Will the widget slow down my site? The widget is lightweight; it loads quickly and does not slow down your pages.

Start using the Jewelry Valuation Widget Subscription today: Subscribe now
